note: 27 Nov 2026, the owner: "can we continue with dials and also do mit's direction edit simultaneously?". MIT-style direction edit, done live first (no weights changed): before serving, the pod finds a direction in the 35B's stream by the difference of means (llama-cvector-generator --method mean) between the start of 40 practice answers that ran out of room and 40 that finished right (try 2's find answers, MATH level-5 train ids 0-99; practice/directions/qwen35-math-cut-vs-finished, made by direction-prep.mjs). Then the live control vector (pod patch 0014, used on Riker with this same engine) steers AWAY from it: x-2, x-5, x-10 over layers 10-29, on 60 FRESH problems (ids 310-369), between two as-built passes, same seeds, judged answer by answer like --confirm. Estimate: 5 passes x ~67 min + direction ~10 min + setup ~30 min = about 6.3 h, about $3.70 on an A40. Caps 7.5 h / $4.50.
